note: Default withdrawn. The inherited value of 0.035 tCO2e/USD mn sat roughly 4,000x below the corporate-lending default in the same units, which is not plausible for project finance as an asset class. No sourced replacement could be established, and inventing one would be worse than shipping none — so the line now contributes nothing until the user supplies an intensity. Registered at zero to record the deliberate absence.
